benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Gold Elite status, including a 25% points bonus on paid stays, enhanced room upgrades when available, and complimentary in-room Wi-Fi.
benefits.terms: Automatic upon card approval; requires a linked Marriott Bonvoy account.

benefits.name: Annual Elite Night Credits
benefits.description: 15 Elite Night Credits toward the next level of Marriott Bonvoy Elite status.
benefits.terms: Credited automatically each calendar year toward elite status qualification.

benefits.name: Annual Free Night Award
benefits.description: One Free Night Award (redeemable at hotels with a redemption level at or under 50,000 Marriott Bonvoy points) after spending $15,000 in eligible purchases on the card in a calendar year.
benefits.terms: Requires $15,000 in eligible calendar-year card spend; not automatic. Points may be added (up to 25,000) to reach higher redemption levels. Resort fees may apply.

benefits.name: Bonus Points per Paid Stay
benefits.description: 1,000 Marriott Bonvoy bonus points per paid eligible stay booked directly with Marriott.
benefits.terms: Applies per qualifying paid stay booked directly with Marriott.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Coverage for eligible new purchases against accidental damage or theft for 90 days.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty
benefits.description: Extends the original manufacturer's U.S. warranty by up to one additional year on eligible warranties of 5 years or less.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement for reasonable expenses when a covered trip is delayed 12+ hours due to a covered reason.

benefits.name: Baggage Insurance
benefits.description: Coverage for lost, damaged, or stolen checked and carry-on baggage on a covered trip.

benefits.name: Car Rental Loss & Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Secondary coverage for damage or theft of most rental vehicles.

earningRates.terms: Eligible purchases at hotels participating in Marriott Bonvoy.
Restaurants worldwide and U.S. supermarkets, on up to $15,000 in combined purchases per calendar year, then 2x.
